def resolve_contacts(first_name):
    page_limit=20
    page_index=0
    all_results=[]
    while True:
        res = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query=first_name, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        results = res if isinstance(res, list) else res.get('success', []) if isinstance(res, dict) else []
        if not results:
            break
        all_results.extend(results)
        if len(results) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1
    exact=[c for c in all_results if (c.get('first_name') or '').lower()==first_name.lower()]
    return exact, all_results
